title: Handoff Maps & Mini Ledger: Onboarding Shotpack for API Key Lifecycle and Streaming Toolcalls
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact set of onboarding illustration assets and annotated handoff maps ("mini ledger") for the API/SDK docs covering: API key lifecycle (create, rotate, revoke), streaming response playback thumbnails, and a lightweight sequence demonstrating tool-calling from a streamed response. Deliverables should be optimized for docs hero strips, in-guide inline images, and small animated GIFs for the Quickstart flow. Focus on clarity for developer audiences and minimal visual noise so screenshots and code snippets remain legible.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 8 static PNG illustrations (1200x630 and 800x420 variants) that explain key creation, scoped key grants, rotation, and revocation flows
Two 6-frame GIFs illustrating: (a) streaming tokens arriving and the client assembling results, (b) upstream tool-call handshake and response insertion into the chat stream
Figma file with organized pages: artboard labels, token/secret redaction, and component library for reuse
Handoff spec doc in Confluence with image export instructions, alt text, and copy-ready microcopy for localizations
Design sign-off from PM and Engineering and a security checklist indicating no real secrets have been embedded in artifacts
design_notes: Use 2-up composition for screens: left column for code snippet, right column for small schematic (max 420px wide)
Color usage: stay within brand neutrals for backgrounds; use accent cyan for active tokens and orange for revocation states
Avoid literal key images; use stylized token chips with truncated hash segments to prevent deceptive real-secret artifacts
GIFs should target 12 FPS and under 800KB after export for docs performance
Provide both a light and a dark background variant for each asset to support the docs theme toggle
handoff_instructions: Export PNGs at 2x and 1x with filenames matching the pattern: onboard_<topic>_<w>x<h>.<ext>
Include image alt text in Confluence table (column: filename | alt_text | caption)
Attach original Figma link and a flattened PDF for archiving
Add a short snippet of suggested microcopy (20–40 chars) per image for inline captions
